document.content:
# Operator Health Check — 2026-03-13 02:51 UTC

## Summary
System resources are currently within safe thresholds, but there are multiple service health issues requiring follow-up.

## PM2
- Online: agent-log, gpu-router, iam-chat-proxy, kira-admin, kira-app, kira-dashboard, oopuo-website, openclaw-bridge, openclaw-gateway, stella-tax, whatsapp-bridge, zenithcred-website
- Issue: `whisper` is `stopped`
- Notable: `openclaw-gateway` shows `online` in PM2 with very high restart count (`1497`) and uptime `0s` at check time

## Docker
- Running containers present across IAM, Omiximo, InvenTree, Langfuse, Evolution API, Ollama, and n8n stacks
- Issues:
  - `langfuse_langfuse-web_1` is `Restarting (1)`
  - `lidaros-frontend-1` is `Up ... (unhealthy)`
  - `omiximo-email-automation` is `Up ... (unhealthy)`

## Disk
- Root filesystem `/dev/sda1`: 452G / 662G used (`69%`)
- No disk alert threshold breached

## Memory
- RAM: 11.6G used / 27.5G total (~42%)
- Available: 15.9G
- Swap: disabled / none configured

## GPU
- NVIDIA RTX 4090 detected
- GPU memory in use: 20550 MiB / 24564 MiB (~84%)
- Utilization: 0% at sample time
- Main process: `VLLM::EngineCore` using ~20.5 GiB VRAM
- No immediate thermal or utilization concern at check time

## OpenClaw Gateway
- `openclaw gateway status` reports RPC probe OK and listener active on `127.0.0.1:18789`
- But service runtime state reports: `stopped (state inactive, sub dead, last exit 203, reason 1)`
- Service config flagged as `out of date or non-standard`
- Recommendation from tooling: `openclaw doctor` and possibly `openclaw gateway install --force`
- Additional config warnings: Telegram/WhatsApp group allowlists are empty, so group messages will be silently dropped for affected accounts

## Overall Assessment
Resource health is acceptable. Service health is degraded. Priority issues are the stopped `whisper` process, failing/unhealthy Docker containers, and the inconsistent OpenClaw gateway service state/configuration.
